why: A is the text's proof in coordinates (compRetraction_retract, proposition_2_21_3/4): for ANY sc-retraction R with retract O and ANY sc-smooth idempotent s of O, at a ∈ s(O)₁ (smooth for (3)), T_aO = Dr(a)E, T_a s(O) = Dt(a)E (t = s ∘ r), the explicit sc-complement (Dr(a) − Dt(a))E levelwise, s : O → s(O) sc-smooth and Ts(a)(T_aO) = T_a s(O). B is the global statement on the tangent bundle of an M-polyfold X, for every structure Q on the sub-M-polyfold with Prop. 2.21 (1),(2): in every chart φ around a ∈ A_∞, the chart images of Ti(a)T_aA and T_aX are submodules with SOME sc-complement, and the chart image of Ts(a)T_aX equals that of T_aA. A ⇒ B is believed true but not proved: the project never transports (3),(4) from the chart to T_aX/T_aA (its gap G.7); it needs the chart image of T_aX = T_{φ(a)}O (proved here, tangentInChartB_eq), A applied to the restricted retraction onto φ(W) with s = φ∘r∘φ⁻¹, and — the bulk — the chain rule showing the chart image of Ti(a)T_aA is T_{φ(a)}φ(W∩A) for an ARBITRARY Q with (1),(2) (via φ∘i∘κ⁻¹ and κ∘(i⁻¹∘r)∘φ⁻¹) plus the mixed-chart computation for Ts(a); several hundred lines of tangent-map glue, not attempted. B ⇒ A fails genuinely: B only asserts existence of a complement in charts of M-polyfolds and says nothing of Dr(a), Dt(a), the specific complement (Dr − Dt)E, compRetraction, or retracts not presented as sub-M-polyfold charts.
overlap: n/a (B_to_A not proved); the two partial lemmas (tangentInChartB_eq: chart image of T_aX = T_{φ(a)}O; induced_isScSmoothOn: B (4)'s sc-smoothness of W → A is B's own hypothesis (2) on Q) pass #rt_check.
